purpose: Freeze and challenge the day-over-day point-in-time price-basis adjustment magnitude before reading any daily source value, candidate value, comparator value, historical OHLCV value or forward return.

candidate.name: daily_realized_price_basis_adjustment_magnitude_1d
candidate.calendar_predecessor_rule: For signal session t, p must be the immediately preceding accepted local trading session. The same symbol must have a source row on both p and t; a suspension gap, missing predecessor or cross-symbol predecessor makes t missing.
candidate.source_identity_rule: Both rows must have price_basis exactly close_known_raw_pct_chg_chain_v1 and the single manifest-accepted daily_source baostock.
candidate.validity: factor_p and factor_t must be finite and strictly positive. No imputation, forward fill, clipping, tolerance, tick rounding or event classification is allowed.
candidate.exact_zero_rule: Exact factor equality is a valid zero and remains in the cross-section; source rounding is not thresholded away.
candidate.availability: Known only after the signal-session close when the accepted same-close pct_chg chain and raw close have produced factor_t; no later factor or future-adjusted history is used.
candidate.interpretation_limit: The derived source state may reflect an ex-right or other reference-price adjustment, but it is not an official corporate-action classification and must not be labelled as a dividend, split or rights event.
candidate.economic_hypothesis: A larger realized reference-price continuity adjustment may create short-lived attention and mechanical portfolio rebalancing that persists from the next open through the third close.

construction_identity.accepted_builder_relation: The upstream point-in-time chain sets adjusted_close_t = adjusted_close_p * (1+pct_chg_t/100) and factor_t = adjusted_close_t/raw_close_t.
construction_identity.ratio_relation: factor_t/factor_p = (1+pct_chg_t/100)/(raw_close_t/raw_close_p) when p is the calendar-adjacent accepted predecessor.

overlap_challenges.reason: Holding factor_t/factor_p fixed while changing the raw close return leaves Campaign136 unchanged. Holding the raw return fixed while changing the close-known pct_chg reference reconciliation changes Campaign136. The factor loads neither raw nor adjusted OHLCV and contains no return sign.

The terminal dividend-plan family uses announcement-dated plan fields and has frozen sparse-capacity outcomes. Campaign136 uses no announcement, plan cash, bonus ratio, event count or freshness; it observes only a realized price-basis reconciliation on the signal date and does not rescue or combine the plan family.
Campaign136 contains no listing date or age, and it requires a calendar-adjacent same-symbol predecessor, which excludes suspension-gap resumptions instead of proxying them.
Multiplying both factor levels by any common positive per-symbol chain constant leaves Campaign136 unchanged, and changing nominal share price with the factor ratio fixed also leaves it unchanged.

The accepted manifest already requires one point-in-time basis, zero nonpositive factor rows, zero pct_chg-chain errors and zero raw-close reconstruction errors. Campaign136 uses the adjacent ratio only after that acceptance and binds the manifest and builder code; it never substitutes future qfq/hfq data.

Candidate49 counts prospective within-session close crossings around causal cumulative VWAP from minute close, volume and amount. Campaign136 is an offline daily price-basis ratio, reads no minute value and never enters or backfills the prospective ledgers.

frozen_counterfactuals: Multiplying every historical factor level for one symbol by one positive constant leaves every Campaign136 value unchanged.
Changing current raw or adjusted OHLCV while preserving the accepted adjacent factor ratio leaves Campaign136 unchanged.
Changing an announcement-dated dividend plan without changing the realized adjacent factor ratio leaves Campaign136 unchanged.
Deleting the calendar-adjacent predecessor row makes the signal date missing; Campaign136 never bridges a suspension or listing gap.
Changing the factor ratio from one to a nonunit positive value changes Campaign136 even if the raw close return is held fixed through a corresponding pct_chg reference change.
rejected_variants_before_values: signed ratio, inverse ratio, upside/downside split or direction search
